question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Equanimity
solution:
The correct answer is 'Agitation'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Equanimity** is a noun that means **calmness and composure, especially in a difficult situation**.

 
 
• *Example - She accepted both the good and the bad with **equanimity**.*
 
 
 
• The meanings of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Agitation - a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.
 
• Assurance - a positive declaration intended to give confidence; a promise.
 
• Serenity - the state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
 
• Calmness - the state or quality of being free from agitation or strong emotion.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that agitation is the correct antonym for the word equanimity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The words serenity and calmness are synonyms of the word equanimity.
